title: Latest update broke Mouse Without Borders: Old key not accepted, and unable to generate new key.
summary: The original report confirms the Settings-sync signer rejection tracked in #50795; consolidate instead of asking for another report.

evidence: The issue reports old-key rejection and failed new-key generation after 0.102.3001 across Windows 10 systems; further replies add mixed Windows 10/11, config reset failure and temporary success after downgrading.
The latest replies confirm the failure persists, including lost UI connection state; they do not supply a separate root cause.

Independent inspection of the original report finds Settings-sync signer rejection, which matches the explicit failure tracked in #50795. The prior assessment looked at MWB-side logs and missed this Settings-side discriminator.
Read the complete body and all current replies, including the newly arrived confirmations; downloaded the original attachment independently.
Inspected the Settings logs rather than restricting the scan to MWB logs. The report contains the same untrusted-signature SettingsSync rejection as #50795.

MouseWithoutBordersViewModel.cs verifies the pipe peer before returning the sync helper; New key only invokes GenerateNewKey through that helper. A rejected helper explains why the button cannot reach the engine.

NamedPipePeerVerification.cs compares trusted signer leaf-certificate bytes; #50795 documents valid but differing release signers and current-release confirmations. This matches the failure class, although this issue does not independently include the executable signature inventory.
Reviewed #50795 body, all replies and cross-links; no linked fix PR or matching fork implementation was found. Consolidation is not a claim that a fix has shipped.
judgment.recommended_action: Link this report to #50795 and carry its current-release/mixed-OS confirmations there; do not create competing design or implementation work.
judgment.rationale: The decisive discriminator is already in the supplied archive. New replies strengthen the regression report, but another key-generation ZIP would repeat supplied evidence. Correct the earlier incomplete scan and preserve the primary tracking issue.

fix_assessment.rationale: No separate fix applies to this duplicate: the confirmed failure belongs to the existing #50795 tracking work. That issue remains unresolved; no concrete implementation is claimed.

comment.body: Thanks for the report and the additional Windows 10/11 and downgrade comparisons. The supplied diagnostic report already identifies the Settings-sync signer rejection tracked in #50795, which prevents Settings from sending the New key request to Mouse Without Borders. There is no need to collect another general report for that discriminator. Please track the fix in #50795; this identifies the existing failure class, not a shipped correction or a recommendation to disable signature verification.
